MT-04 / Three gates

Our system's three gates: a 700 score, cards at 30% or less, and zero negatives.

  • This sample clears two of them, a 706 score and nothing negative, and fails card use at 88%.
  • We review your file the way a lender does, so the failing gate gets handled first.
  • Our system has three gates: a score of 700 or more, cards used 30% or less, and zero negative items. That's the cutoff the whole $128,040 turns on.
  • This sample clears two of them. The score is a 706, and there's nothing negative anywhere on the file, on any of the three bureaus.
  • Card use is the gate it FAILS, and failing it keeps the file out of full funding, however good that 706 looks on paper.
  • Paid down to 10%, card use clears that gate too. Now all three gates pass, and the very same file routes to full funding.
  • That's what we do first. We review your file the way a lender does, find the gate it fails, and fix it BEFORE an application goes out.
